core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nissa is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Women”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nissa corresponds to the Arabic form نِسَاء (Arabic root ن س و (n-s-w); نِسَاء (Nisāʾ)). Its core sense is women. Nissa is a spelling variant of Arabic نِسَاء (Nisāʾ) 'women', from the root ن س و (n-s-w). The source gloss 'Women, Lady' is consistent. Same name as nisa.

persian.name: نساء
